name: forex-sniper
description: Multi-market EUR/USD, BTC/USD and XAU/USD signal research

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/options-flow.js && node --check src/market-regime.js && node --check src/macro.js && node --check src/market.js && node --check src/sessions.js && node --check src/signal.js && node --check src/trade-plan.js && node --check src/download.js && node --check src/backtest.js && node --check src/session-performance.js && node --check src/live-feed.js && node --check src/gold-news.js
scripts.backtest:all: MARKET=EURUSD node src/backtest.js && MARKET=BTCUSD node src/backtest.js && MARKET=XAUUSD node src/backtest.js
scripts.backtest:experiments: MARKET=EURUSD SIGNAL_PROFILE=strict node src/backtest.js && MARKET=BTCUSD SIGNAL_PROFILE=strict node src/backtest.js
scripts.backtest:advanced: MARKET=EURUSD SIGNAL_PROFILE=advanced node src/backtest.js && MARKET=BTCUSD SIGNAL_PROFILE=advanced node src/backtest.js
scripts.backtest:institutional: MARKET=EURUSD SIGNAL_PROFILE=institutional node src/backtest.js && MARKET=BTCUSD SIGNAL_PROFILE=institutional node src/backtest.js
scripts.backtest:holdout: BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 MARKET=EURUSD node src/backtest.js && BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 MARKET=BTCUSD node src/backtest.js && BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 MARKET=XAUUSD node src/backtest.js
scripts.backtest:holdout:advanced: BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 SIGNAL_PROFILE=advanced MARKET=EURUSD node src/backtest.js && BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 SIGNAL_PROFILE=advanced MARKET=BTCUSD node src/backtest.js
scripts.backtest:holdout:institutional: BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 SIGNAL_PROFILE=institutional MARKET=EURUSD node src/backtest.js && BACKTEST_START_RATIO=0.7 SIGNAL_PROFILE=institutional MARKET=BTCUSD node src/backtest.js
